app.name: Song Maker
library.empty: No songs yet. Create the first one.
library.title: Title
library.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? The entire folder will be erased.
workspace.create.title: Create
workspace.create.intro: Name the song, describe the style and lyrics, then generate. Optional settings stay separate.
workspace.score.title: Score / Cover
workspace.score.intro: Choose between editing a score and covering a song from audio. Only actions that apply to the current state are shown.
workspace.score.repriseHint: To start from existing audio, open Cover (SheetSage2).
workspace.production.title: Production
workspace.versions.title: Versions
form.createIntro: Start with your idea and lyrics. Other settings are optional.
form.title: Song name
form.style.hint: Describe the instruments, energy, and voice you have in mind.
form.style.hintInstrumental: Describe the instruments, energy, and mood — with no sung vocals.
form.instrumental.hint: Lyrics become optional. YuE2 receives an empty string and generates without vocal text.
form.audioInput.incapacity: Audio reference / inpainting: YuE2 and ACE-Step do not consume audio_input. There is no “one phrase without regenerating everything”. A SheetSage2 cover is not audio input to the decoder.
form.houseModel.unavailable: In-house model: no generation in the app (no weights, no decoder). Recipe lives outside the app: scripts/model-training/. YuE2 / ACE-Step remain the engines.
form.lyrics.tagsInstrumental: Leave empty for an instrumental. You can also add structure tags (e.g. [Intro], [Instrumental], [Outro]) with no sung text.
form.error.title: Invalid title (1–120 characters, no / \ : * ? " < > | and no trailing period).
form.error.duration: Target duration: 0:30 to 6:00, in 30 s steps.
form.advanced.hint: Optional: language, tempo, duration, plan, key, meter, and seed.
form.advanced.cardHint: Language, tempo, duration, and expert parameters — summary of active values below.
form.parameter.sound.title: Duration and performance
form.parameter.sound.intro: Sung language, tempo, target duration, and ending rule.
form.parameter.sound.cardHint: Language, BPM, duration, and ending policy.
form.parameter.plan.title: Musical plan
form.parameter.plan.intro: Choose the musical information YuE should return with the generation.
form.parameter.plan.cardHint: Plan and score returned after generation.
form.parameter.key.title: Key
form.parameter.key.intro: Let YuE choose the key, or set a root note and mode.
form.parameter.key.cardHint: Root note and major or minor mode.
form.parameter.meter.title: Meter
form.parameter.meter.intro: Meter sets how many beats are in each bar and how long those beats last.
form.parameter.seed.title: Generation seed
form.parameter.seed.intro: A fixed seed helps you try to reproduce a generation. Leave the field empty to vary.
form.parameter.seed.cardHint: Set a seed or leave a new automatic value.
form.plan.fullHint: YuE can also return a score with the song.
form.plan.melodyHint: YuE focuses on the melodic plan.
form.plan.offHint: The song is generated with no score returned.
form.language.hint: Leave empty if you have no preference.
form.tempo.hint: Beats per minute. The final tempo may vary slightly.
form.duration.hint: The song may run longer than this to finish the lyrics.
form.duration.strictActiveHint: With strict duration, lyrics may be left unfinished.
form.duration.policy: If duration and lyrics do not match
form.duration.preferLyricsHint: The song may exceed the target duration.
form.duration.strict: Cut at the duration even if lyrics stop short
form.duration.strictHint: Stops at the chosen limit; the end of the lyrics may be missing.
form.meter.hint: Number of beats in each bar (for example 4/4 or 3/4).
form.seed.hint: Enter a generation’s seed to try to reproduce it.
separate.again.confirm: A new separation creates a new mix: current settings on AI stems reset from scratch. Imported or recorded tracks are kept.
separate.recommend.title: Choose a separation model
separate.recommend.intro: Recommendation by stem type, with time for each quality option.
separate.recommend.unverifiedWarn: The selected model has no verified license. Continue anyway?
separate.recommend.unverifiedBanner: The recommended model ({model}) has license status “{status}”. A warning will appear before launch.
separate.license.blocked: Check “I have read the license” before downloading.
separate.license.exclusionsSummary: {count} models not offered in Song Maker.
separate.license.htdemucs.missing: HTDemucs GGUF missing — download requires reading the license (Demucs #327).
separate.model.unavailable: This model is not installed. Download it first (after accepting the license).
separation.revert.hint: You can return to the previous separation and its mix.
export.tracks.title: Export tracks
export.tracks.hint: Copies WAV files from the active separation (no recalculation).
export.tracks.disabledNoStems: Separate the tracks or wait for separation to finish.
export.tracks.disabledNoneSelected: Check at least one track to export.
export.dialog.title: Export
export.dialog.intro: One screen for the mix and the tracks. Options unused by the chosen format are hidden.
export.stems.mp3Unsupported: Aligned stems export only as WAV or FLAC.
export.wizard.title: Stems and portable package
export.wizard.intro: Export aligned stems (origin bar 1 / time 0) or a project archive you can reopen elsewhere. Non-destructive.
export.stems.title: Aligned stems
export.stems.hint: Same duration and origin for each selected track — reimport into a DAW with no offset.
export.package.title: Portable project package
export.package.hint: Manifest, score/MIDI, mix, production overlay, and media — no model weights or secrets.
export.package.missing: {count} missing media reported — export continues without them.
mix.needSeparation: Stereo mix only — separate the tracks to adjust them one by one, or import / record a custom track.
copilot.intro: Local mix analysis (and the score if present). Each proposal can be reviewed, previewed when possible, and is applied only after explicit confirmation.
copilot.localOnly: Local processing by default. No audio or text is sent remotely for this analysis.
copilot.restored: Mix and effects restored from the snapshot.
copilot.empty: Nothing notable to propose right now.
copilot.stale: The project has changed since analysis — run analysis again. Nothing is applied silently.
copilot.needStemsHint: Without stems, automatic balance and A/B gain preview are unavailable; other proposals may still appear.
copilot.previewUnavailable: A/B preview is available only for selected gain proposals.
copilot.matchGain: A/B compensation for comparable volume: {gain} (listen only)
copilot.scoreHintOnly: Hint only — open the Score tab to fix it.
copilot.change.saveVersion: Save a new mix version after applying
mix.assist.intro: Intent presets and automatic balance — revisable starting points, not a professional mix.
mix.presets.title: Presets by intent
mix.presets.intro: Applies supported gains, pans, and effects. Missing roles are skipped; clips and custom tracks stay.
mix.presets.vocalsForward.blurb: Vocals more present, accompaniment back, light compressor and shelf EQ on vocals.
mix.presets.energetic.blurb: Drums and bass more prominent, gentle limiter on drums, shelf EQ veil on the accompaniment.
mix.presets.softAiry.blurb: Quieter levels, light stereo reverb, and shelf EQ (not a parametric EQ).
mix.presets.applied: Preset “{name}” applied. Adjust each track as usual afterward.
mix.presets.restored: Previous mix restored (preset levels, pans, and effects).
mix.presets.honesty: Same path for playback and export. This is not automatic mastering.
mix.balance.title: Balance automatically
mix.balance.intro: Measures useful levels per stem and proposes bounded starting gains by role. Confirm before applying.
mix.balance.needStems: Stems required to measure and propose a balance.
mix.balance.limitedBoost: boost limited to avoid clipping or extreme gain
mix.balance.matchGain: A/B compensation for comparable volume: {gain} (listen only, not saved)
mix.balance.honesty: Revisable starting point — not automatic professional mixing or mastering. Undo with Ctrl+Z after applying.
record.title: Record a track
record.intro: Mic or line input. Native path (shared WASAPI / ALSA / Core Audio) or WebView fallback. Monitoring off by default.
record.engine.nativeUnavailable: No native device — WebView fallback. Exclusive WASAPI and ASIO are not shipped.
record.latency.hint: AudioContext measurement (base + output). Native path: shared WASAPI via cpal — not exclusive, not ASIO. See docs/capture-low-latency.md.
record.latency.hintNative: Latency estimated from the native buffer size (not a speaker-to-mic round trip). Exclusive WASAPI and ASIO are out of scope.
record.monitor.nativeOff: No hardware monitoring on the native v1 path (avoids a second WebView graph). Listen outside the app or switch to WebView.
record.monitor.warn: Watch for feedback. Compensate latency if monitoring feels late.
record.monitor.compensate: Delay monitoring by the estimated latency
record.err.permission: Microphone permission denied. Allow microphone access in Windows or the browser, then try again.
record.err.noDevice: No microphone or line input found.
record.err.deviceBusy: The device is busy or inaccessible.
record.err.deviceGone: The device was disconnected. Recording stopped; no broken track was added.
record.err.unsupported: Audio recording is not available in this environment.
record.err.writeFailed: Writing the take failed — track not created.
record.err.nativeUnavailable: No native input device. Switch to the WebView fallback or connect an interface.
waveform.label: Waveform
separation.warn.title: Estimated separation
separation.warn.estimated: Tracks are estimates: bleed, phase artifacts, and degraded transients are possible.
separation.warn.guitarPianoUnavailable: Guitar and piano are not isolated by this separator.
separation.warn.experimentalGuitarPiano: Guitar and piano tracks are experimental.
separation.warn.pianoLessReliable: The piano track is less reliable.
separation.warn.bsRoformerOnly: BS-RoFormer isolates only vocals and accompaniment.
separation.warn.drumsBassUnavailable: Drums, bass, guitar, and piano are not available with this separator.
separation.warn.pianoBleedMask: Piano-bleed mask applied to the other stems; the piano stem itself is not cleaned.
separation.warn.pianoHeavy6s: Not recommended for a piano-heavy mix: piano bleed. Prefer HTDemucs 4 stems. A spectral mask reduces bleed in the other stems; the piano is not cleaned.
clips.title: Clips
clips.cutAt: Split planned at {ms} ms (click the clip, or Alt+click)
clips.takes.hint: Select the audible take. Others stay on the track (non-destructive comping). Split to combine regions.
clips.stretch.ab: Turn processing off to hear the original with no loss. Playback and export share the same bake.
clips.stretch.quality.polyphony_caution: Dense polyphony: artifacts possible; listen before export.
clips.stretch.quality.extreme_ratio: Extreme ratio or transposition — reduced quality.
midi.title: MIDI instrument
midi.hint: Offline preview and recording — notes stay editable; no render overwrites the MIDI.
midi.unsupported: Web MIDI unavailable in this environment.
midi.recordDone: MIDI take added to the score (symbolic data kept).
midi.recordHint: Captured notes join the active voice. MIDI/ABC export unchanged; no replacement by rendered audio.
midi.sf2.loaded: {name} — {n} preset(s). Sample playback, not a complete GM set.
midi.sf2.failed: Unreadable SF2 file. The instrument stays on oscillators.
midi.sf2.cleared: SF2 bank removed — back to oscillators.
candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.hint: Sequential calls on one GPU. No automatic winner.
candidates.selected: Take kept for comparison: {id}. Use “Use this take” to activate it.
candidates.noAutoWinner: Choose a take — the product does not pick a winner.
versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Takes and important moments, newest first. Technical IDs stay in Details.
versions.interrupted.title: Generation interrupted, unusable
versions.pills.label: Take contents
versions.interrupted.retryBlockedForm: Complete the Create tab (valid style and lyrics) to retry generation.
versions.event.separationGlobal: Global event: tracks separated (not attached to a take)
versions.separations.title: Separations
versions.separations.hint: Each separation keeps its tracks and associated mix.
stopAfter.generateScoreOnlyHint: stop_after=abc — score without WAV. Cot melody|full, no external ABC. Then render audio from this score.
stopAfter.renderFromScoreHint: Source {id} (score.abc immutable). Each take has this parent.
stopAfter.renderFromScoreEmpty: No generation with score.abc — generate a score-only take first.
score.abcMeta.aligned: ABC metadata aligned with the request ({detail}). Model notes were not transposed.
score.abcPreview.truncated: Preview of the first {shown} lines of {total} — copy for the full text.
score.blankCreated: Empty score created — edit the piano roll.
score.emptyCta: Import MIDI or create an empty score to open the piano roll.
score.none: No user score. Phase 1 generation (style + lyrics) remains available.
score.transposeHint: Selection only if a note is selected; otherwise the whole voice.
score.pianoHint: Double-click: add · drag: move · Delete / arrows: edit
score.validationFailed: Score invalid for YuE2 ABC export.
score.cotOffBlocked: ABC with cot=off is not allowed.
score.willSendAbc: A validated ABC will be sent with this generation.
score.phase1Path: Without a score: style + lyrics generation only.
score.vocalToInsHint: Instrumental conversion on the ABC preview (no LoRA).
score.phase2Note: Phase 2 score editor: synced ABC staff, piano roll, clips, candidates, stop_after=abc (score only + multi-render).
score.view.abcEmpty: No exportable ABC — fix the score or open the piano roll.
score.staff.syncHint: Start playback to sync the cursor.
score.staff.seekNoAudio: No audio source ready — click cannot follow playback.
score.staff.seekUnavailable: Could not place this note in playback time.
score.staff.emptyAbc: Empty ABC — nothing to show on the staff.
score.staff.renderIssueSummaryOne: 1 bar could not be displayed. Sound is unaffected.
score.staff.renderIssuesSummary: {count} bars could not be displayed. Sound is unaffected.
score.staff.unavailable: This score cannot be shown on a staff (ABC export refused).
score.staff.switchPiano: Switch to the piano roll to edit, then return to the staff.
score.branchHint: Each save creates an immutable score-v*. Create a named branch, compare, then merge with explicit conflict resolution.
score.branchNeedDoc: Open or create a score before branching.
score.branchBootstrap: Use “{action}” or import MIDI to start.
score.mergeUnresolved: Resolve all note conflicts before merging.
score.mergeOk: Merge saved as a new version.
score.mergeNoSilent: No silent merge: each conflict must be chosen.
generations.title: Generations
generations.lyricsTruncated: YuE hit the generation limit. The end of the lyrics may be missing; increase the target duration or shorten the text.
generations.continueHint: Add remaining lyrics here. YuE will resume from this take’s audio tokens and create a new version linked to it.
generations.useHint: The active separation will be detached: stems will no longer match.

settings.audioAndLoraHint: Optional settings to isolate tracks and install style adapters.
settings.integrationsHint: Remote worker, host mode, and style catalog. Local generation remains the default.
settings.home.hint: Choose a section to see its settings and what they do.
settings.separation.title: Track separation
settings.lora.title: LoRA and styles
settings.remote.title: Remote GPU worker
settings.host.title: Akasha integration

settings.card.model: Choose the YuE2 model based on available memory.
settings.card.separation: Choose how to isolate vocals and instruments.
settings.card.lora: Browse style packs and manage installed adapters.
settings.card.remote: Remote GPU worker (opt-in). HTTP contract required; disabled = zero network.
settings.card.sync: Optional project sync — cloud not shipped; opt-in per song.
settings.card.host: Enable the local adapter for host integration.
settings.card.system: GPU, audio runtime, folders, and output device.
settings.system.description: Diagnostic information and paths used by Song Maker.
settings.language.hint: French or English. The choice is remembered on this computer.
licenses.loraOptional: Optional LoRA packs (phases 3–4, including styles) — CC BY-NC 4.0, not in the installer; see Settings → LoRA and styles.

phase3.settings.title: Track separation
phase3.settings.intro: Choose how to extract vocals and instruments from the song.
phase3.separator.title: Stem separator
phase3.separator.bsMissing: BS-RoFormer GGUF missing or invalid (not included in the installer).
phase3.separator.bsInstallOk: BS-RoFormer installed and registered. Selectable after probe.
phase3.separator.bsInstallHint: Opt-in download from Hugging Face (audio-cpp/audio.cpp-gguf). HTDemucs remains the default separator. Vocals + instrumental only.
phase3.separator.bsInstallMeta: Size {size} · SHA-256 {sha}… · disk space and fingerprint verified.
phase3.separator.melMissing: Mel-Band RoFormer GGUF missing or invalid (not included in the installer).
phase3.separator.melInstallOk: Mel-Band RoFormer installed and registered. Selectable after probe.
phase3.separator.melInstallHint: Opt-in download from Hugging Face (audio-cpp/audio.cpp-gguf). Vocals + instrumental. License unverified (no confirmed primary source). HTDemucs remains the default separator.
phase3.separator.onnxRuntimeMissing: ONNX runtime missing. Install it to enable this separator.
phase3.unavailable: unavailable (not exposed by HTDemucs / BS-RoFormer audio.cpp)
phase3.lora.title: Style packs for YuE2 (LoRA)
phase3.lora.intro: Metadata only — no weights in the repo or first-build installer. CC BY-NC 4.0.
phase3.lora.ccGate: I accept CC BY-NC 4.0 for optional LoRA packs (no monetization).
phase3.lora.manualDownload: Plan only — or use “Download to cache”. No weights in the repo.
phase3.lora.downloadOk: Files saved to the cache (outside the installer):
phase3.mix.title: Production tools
phase3.mix.intro: Set automation, effects, and sidechain on separated tracks. Settings apply to playback and export.
phase3.mix.wiredIdle: No tools active — playback and export use the simple mix.
phase3.mix.wiredActive: Tools active — playback and export go through the production engine (approximation, not bit-identical).
phase3.mix.needMix: Separate the tracks first to set automation.
phase3.mix.automationHint: Click to add a point, drag to move, double-click to delete. X axis ≈ 0–5 s.
phase3.mix.automationHintDuration: Click to add a point, drag to move, double-click to delete. X axis ≈ 0–{sec} s (project duration).
phase3.routing.title: Groups, aux buses, and sends
phase3.routing.intro: Group tracks under a bus, send to an aux (pre/post-fader). Cycles and missing destinations are detected and detached without losing source content.
phase3.routing.busesEmpty: No buses — create a group or an aux.
phase3.mix.fxHint: Limiter, dynamics, filters, shelf / parametric EQ, tempo-sync delay, reverb, vocal cleanup, and vocal pitch correction (same bake for playback / export). Mixing tools — not automatic mastering. Custom effects outside registered extensions are refused.
phase4.settings.title: Advanced tools and integrations
phase4.settings.intro: Options for users who configure models or external services.
phase4.assistant.title: Editing assistant
phase4.assistant.intro: Suggestions from ABC validation errors — no LLM agent.
phase4.invariants.title: Conservation invariants (§11.3)
phase4.invariants.intro: Checks events (not ABC text) before a regeneration.
phase4.invariants.needBaseline: Capture a reference first, then edit and check.
phase4.invariants.persisted: Reference saved for this project (survives reload).
phase4.regenGate.title: Conservation before regeneration
phase4.regenGate.intro: Choose the conservation level. The current score becomes the reference before generation starts.
phase4.regenGate.firstGen: First generation with a score: the reference will be captured for later regenerations.
phase4.regenGate.proceedBlocked: No reference score — capture impossible before regeneration.
phase4.regenGate.decide: Confirm the new score or return to the reference.
phase4.remote.title: Remote GPU worker
phase4.remote.enable: Allow remote worker (opt-in — local remains the default)
phase4.remote.retentionAck: I have read the retention notice (24 h max, delete after download)
phase4.remote.tokenHint: Or environment variable {env}. No real IdP yet.
phase4.remote.probeContract: The endpoint must implement docs/remote-worker-contract.md. No silent local fallback.
phase4.remote.contractHint: Reference worker: packages/remote-worker-server (docs/remote-worker/). Disabled = zero network calls.
phase4.remote.confirmNoFallback: On failure, local generation does not start automatically.
phase4.remote.needRetention: Check the retention acknowledgment in Settings first.
phase4.sync.title: Project sync (optional)
phase4.sync.intro: Local-first: opt-in sync per project (NAS/USB folder or self-hosted HTTP server). Never required.
phase4.sync.notImplemented: Transport unavailable outside the Tauri app. See docs/project-sync-contract.md.
phase4.sync.localWorks: Local mode always works, with or without opt-in.
phase4.sync.pickProject: Open a song (library) to enable per-project opt-in.
phase4.sync.confirmDelete: Delete the remote copy of this project?
phase4.host.title: Host mode (Akasha / DeclUI)
phase4.host.intro: Discovery of a real Akasha host (opt-in). With no reachable URL: integration clearly unavailable — no fake connected mode. Local desktop unchanged.
phase4.host.embeddedIntro: Embedded DeclUI host: local 127.0.0.1 process, same discovery protocol. YuE2 stays on the desktop. No public bind. Connect below remains opt-in.
vst3.spike.title: VST3 spike (experimental — not a DAW host)
phase4.host.desktop: Local desktop mode (default). No host integration active.
phase4.host.connected: Akasha host connected — music API / DeclUI discovered.
phase4.host.unavailable: Akasha / DeclUI integration unavailable (local adapter only).
phase4.host.enabled: Akasha host connected — music API / DeclUI discovered.
phase4.host.envHint: Or variables {urlEnv} / {tokenEnv}. No network calls without opt-in.
phase4.styleLora.title: Style LoRA catalog
phase4.styleLora.intro: Unfused packs loadable via yue2.ar_lora / yue2.nar_lora. Outside the first-build installer — opt-in download only.
phase4.styleLora.licenseNotice: CC BY-NC 4.0 license: non-commercial use only. No monetization or redistribution of weights is offered. Accept the license before any download.
phase4.styleLora.ccAccepted: CC BY-NC 4.0 accepted for optional LoRA packs.
phase4.styleLora.ccCleared: CC BY-NC consent withdrawn — LoRA downloads disabled. Standard generation remains available.
phase4.styleLora.deactivated: LoRA adapters deactivated. The next generation will use YuE2 without LoRA.
phase4.styleLora.activated: Pack “{name}” activated — paths and scales saved for yue2.ar_lora / yue2.nar_lora.
phase4.styleLora.activateMissing: Cannot activate: no pack file has a local path. Download to the cache first.
phase4.styleLora.activateFailed: Activation refused (file missing, corrupt, or outside cache/models/lora). Standard generation without LoRA remains available.
phase4.styleLora.downloadHintActivate: Then click “Activate for generation” to load the pack via audio.cpp session options.
phase4.lora.localHint: Select unfused SafeTensors files in the cache models/lora folder. Any change restarts the audio server before the next generation.
phase4.lora.importHint: Import one or more YuE2 SafeTensors files, then choose them as the AR or NAR adapter. Files are copied into the Song Maker cache.
phase4.lora.imported: Library refreshed: {count} LoRA(s) available. Check YuE2 compatibility before generating.
phase4.lora.saved: LoRA configuration saved. The YuE2 server will use these adapters on the next generation.

sheetsage.intro: Transcribe a track or mixdown to ABC, correct it, open an editable MIDI draft, confirm, then start a new YuE2 generation. SheetSage2 weights are opt-in (~2.7 GB, CC BY-NC 4.0) — downloadable from this screen.
sheetsage.step.mode: Choose the mode (melody or full plan)
sheetsage.step.scoreDraft: Open the draft in the piano roll (editable MIDI)
sheetsage.license: I accept the CC BY-NC 4.0 license for SheetSage2 weights (non-commercial use of the weights).
sheetsage.licenseLimits: Commercial use of the weights is forbidden.
sheetsage.install.hint: Weights are not in the first-build installer. Opt-in download here after accepting the license.
sheetsage.install.needLicense: Accept the CC BY-NC 4.0 license before downloading the weights.
sheetsage.install.needDesktop: SheetSage2 download requires the desktop app (Tauri).
sheetsage.abcPlaceholder: ABC proposed by SheetSage2 — or paste a score to test YuE2 without the runtime.
sheetsage.pasteHint: Without SheetSage2 weights/binary, paste valid ABC to validate confirmation → YuE2. No fake score is invented.
sheetsage.scoreDraftHint: Editable draft: pitch, start, duration. Correct, quantize, or export as MIDI. Source audio is never modified. Transcription is imperfect (silence, vibrato, polyphony).
sheetsage.scoreDraftEmpty: No notes detected in the ABC — nothing opened in the piano roll.
sheetsage.needConfirm: Confirm the score first — no YuE2 call without confirmation.
sheetsage.nVoices.hint: 2 voices = Vocal/Ins melody (YuE2). 3–8 voices: distinct instruments in Score / piano roll. YuE2 only regenerates Vocal+Ins. Drums are approximate. CC BY-NC license unchanged.
sheetsage.confirmed: Score confirmed. Current style: {style}. Ready for YuE2.
loraTrain.title: NAR LoRA training (pilot)
loraTrain.intro: Isolated local NAR training: validated corpus, jobs persisted under training-jobs/, worker scripts/lora-train-nar.py. See docs/lora-training-pilot.md.
loraTrain.rights: I confirm I have the rights to use these recordings for local training.
loraTrain.noAutoActivate: The adapter is never activated automatically. audio.cpp validation + A/B listen before catalog.
loraTrain.kind.narHint: audio.cpp format / load. This is not official YuE2 GPU training.
loraTrain.kind.gpuHint: CUDA + torch, pins aligned with the desktop runtime. Adapter stays inactive until A/B.
loraTrain.kind.gpuNoCuda: No CUDA: YuE2 GPU LoRA refused. Use the CPU NAR pilot or an NVIDIA machine.
error.gpu: This build requires NVIDIA CUDA. Windows driver ≥ 551.61, or Linux ≥ 570.26 for the pinned archive.
error.models: Download YuE2 Q8 (or Q4) and HTDemucs.
error.vram: Insufficient GPU memory. Chosen pack: {pack}. Detected VRAM: {vram}.
cancel.message: Cancel requested. The GPU call already started will finish; files already written stay.
